notes.title: Sock It 1.0.3 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
New patch with some issues fixed! Hopefully they didn't cause you much of a hassle.


Fixed the checkpoint for some running stages being set to a high default value erroneously, skipping some content. (Sorry!)
Fixed Jeffiro being able to set the timer again for his super form, effectively cheating and disqualifying him from the tournament. (However, contractually we can't remove him from the game, so that's now considered an exhibition round.)

notes.title: Sock It 1.0.2 patch out now!!!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Sock It just updated to 1.0.2!
Lots of changes to improve your experience, with some more to come very soon!


Fight 4: Fixed Alpha Piston sometimes not flipping with Vort's Gravity Rush attack, and hitting his head on the rafters. Ow.
Fight 5: Re recorded one line that was erroneously mistaken for a very bad word.
Fight 7: Fixed the input inversion option not working.
Fight 10: Fixed the timer not starting up again after Shotgut's special attack (He hit it with the chainsaw, we had to get a new one).
Fight 10: Fixed Shotgut's anger issues that led him to keep attacking Alpha Piston when he's down.
Fight 11: Fixed the wrong theme sometimes playing after Alpha Piston gets up.
Fight 12: Fixed the boss's head being shrouded in shadows after winning the match sometimes (You've already won! There's nothing to gain from being mysterious!)
Running 4: Made Gladilade's target more visible, and distinct.
All dreams: Fixed the input inversion option not working.
Fixed minor graphical text error in a late cutscene sequence
Fixed a (very spoilery) detail disappearing in a very late game fight
Fixed many grammatical errors. The luchador boxing glove man would be proud.
Fixed the mixing in the song "Can you play that song again?"



Thanks so much for the continued support! Spread the word! This game cool!

Check out the game's discord, we don't bite!

https://discord.com/invite/EDwmxRQCYK

notes.title: DEMO VERSION 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Hello, have a new update out:

UI:
*Added animation to lifebars! They animate when lowering, and glow white, and shake around a little.

Ranks and Scores:
*Added colors to combo ranks to enforce how cool you are! You can get bronze, silver and gold. Are you able to get the rainbow 128x multiplier?
*Added colors to the victory screen to signify performance. Bronze is C, Silver is B, Gold is A, and there's a rainbow S rank. And of course, there's the obligatory brown F rank.
*Added rainbow to S ranked stages in the replay menu to signify that you got the S rank. Nice job!

Dialogue:
*Made the intro smoother and leaner
*Added like 2 jokes

Other:
*Made Vince the Fridge a teensie bit more stable
*Improved graphics for the intro cutscene
*Balanced scoring system a bit

Still working on the main game, been over halfway done with the campaign for a bit now. Will be busy for a bit, but will work on it when I can.

notes.title: 1.4.0 update to Demo!
notes.notes:
Hi! Lots of changes to the Sock It Demo have been made to improve the experience, with some more on the way. Here's the list:

Balance:

 Nerfed the final segment of the running stage, now platforms are bigger, and the whole thing is designed more fairly
​ Nerfed Vince the Fridge's desperation attack to be a little easier to dodge.
 Made it so, if damage is taken at all, the combo is lost. Now it is more challenging to get points.

Visual:

 Added bullet trails to Ashley's introduction. Oooooh!
 Removed sprite filtering, so now the image is more crisp
 Added a slight rotation to bosses. Adds personality, and the effect of them being hit by a punch in the face.
 Added rope physics to the ring. (Thanks so much to NeZvers). This change isn't too notable, but the rope  physics are being used more substantially in a future boss.​
 Improved graphics, such as running skull

Audio:

 Fixed audio clipping in some instances


Bugs:

 Fixed nasty softlock if the timer goes off with the Glass Cannon. Sorry!
 Fixed Glass Cannon falling over in a muted fashion. Honestly kinda scary.

Other:

 Overhauled tutorial animations. Now it's clearer how the game should be played based on how the punching bag behaves.
 Added link to the official Discord server. Join or you'll be isekai'd into At the Mountains of Madness!
Couple more changes are underway, these will take a bit.

Thanks!

-PowerUpT

notes.title: 1.2.0 Update - Big fixes and changes!
notes.notes:
Hi,

This was a patch that I meant to get out weeks ago when I was seeing a certain livestreamer having issues with it.

But I was on vacation with no computer access.

Then I got sick immediately after I got home.

And I got a bit busy after that.

But I finally did some fixes, even though it's probably way too late now.

Here they are:


Removed reference from punching bag in tutorial (NOTE: There was confusion as to what the bag was. A couple of years ago I made a terrible parody game called Meegah Mem II. The quip was not insulting Mega Man's design, but rather a self deprecative joke about my terrible game. I'm sorry for the confusion.)
Added punch hit sounds (Now it's more clear when you did hit the enemy. There is still a block sound when you hit a blocking opponent.)
Added attack cues for all bosses (Now all bosses have a cue before they attack. Hopefully this helps make it clear when you can't hit them because they're charging up.)
Added dizzy cue for all bosses (Now when an opponent is stunned, a dizzy swirl thing floats above their head and it emits a noise to let you know it's time to wail on them! It also blinks a bit before disappearing. so you know time's almost up.)
Various audio fixes (For your ears)
Nerfed time to mash to get up significantly (This was a huge issue someone had with the game. I playtested on keyboard mainly, I really didn't see the issue of mashing on controller until I saw a bunch of people try it and quit when they couldn't get up. Sorry!)
Fixed cutscene names not displaying correctly (No, Ashley is not Clance.)


I'll be keeping my eyes out for other bug fixes, but it should be more stable now.

Some people had contention with the humor in the cutscenes. I am revising the script for the dialogue in the demo, but that will take a bit, Honestly, I'm a little at odds with it myself because I did so many passes on the other parts of the script that I think they turned out way better. Stay tuned!

Thanks!
